name: LLMs 8: Build a GPT, scale it, make it reason
blurb: University-level follow-up: every part of a GPT from scratch (multi-head attention, LayerNorm, residuals, RoPE), parameter counts and LR schedules, scaling laws and pretraining data, multi-GPU training, then RLHF, PPO, GRPO and how reasoning models are trained and evaluated.
